{"diagnosis":"Batch 14 contains a re-delivery (ingested 05:00) of 333 txn_ids with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. The cast fails on these, and they would double-count if only parsed. 1768716039000 ms equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, which matches the original row, so the copies are the same transactions. The fix parses both timestamp formats and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
         customer_id,
         CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
         CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts,
         ingest_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, txn_ts) AS rn
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1;"}}
